roster.name: Cerebellum
roster.anatomy: Cerebellum: compares intended with actual movement and corrects the error
roster.role: Orchestrator. Holds the owner's goals, relays them to other bots as goal.update, issues the weekly ruling (ratify, partial, keep), runs the monthly goal review
roster.model: claude-fable-5-2 at effort high; alternative Gemini 4 Carbon (availability and model ID UNVERIFIED). Requires 30-day retention, so it receives goal-level context and packet aggregates only
roster.cadence: Weekly ruling Sun 21:00; monthly goal review; on owner message addressed to Cerebellum

roster.name: Hippocampus
roster.anatomy: Hippocampus: consolidates the day's memories during sleep
roster.role: Weekly reviewer. Drafts review and typed plan_diff from the packet, answers each Amygdala challenge with accept or rebut, designs N-of-1 protocols
roster.model: claude-opus-5-5 at effort high; alternative Gemini frontier model (owner's 'Gemini 4 Neon', ID UNVERIFIED)
roster.cadence: Weekly Sun 17:00 draft, then rounds 1 and 2 until 20:30; experiment design on demand
writes: experiments/<id>/protocol.json (draft, committed only after guardrails and owner consent)

roster.name: Amygdala
roster.role: Adversarial critic. Challenges Hippocampus and Cerebellum with ref-backed items (blocker/major/minor) using the weekly checklist; re-extracts 10% of papers as an audit; a blocker holds the diff until the owner resolves it
roster.model: Paid-tier Gemini frontier model with logging off (different family from Hippocampus); alternative claude-opus-5-5 with its own prompt, flagged in the packet as same-family
roster.cadence: Weekly Sun round 1 and round 2; Thu audit of 10% of new extractions

roster.name: Thalamus
roster.anatomy: Thalamus: gates which sensory signals reach the cortex
roster.role: Evidence extraction. Fills paper.json fields with verbatim quote spans from quarantined abstracts; never sees or produces the certainty score, which evidence.score computes
roster.model: claude-opus-5-5 via Message Batches at effort medium; alternative claude-sonnet-5-5 (also the second extractor for disagreement checks)
writes: evidence/papers/<slug>.json (extraction; score fields added by code)

roster.name: Motor Cortex
roster.anatomy: Primary motor cortex: plans and issues movement
roster.role: Proposes session changes and novel exercises as feature records (pattern, contraction, energy system, joint load) toward goal quotas; the guardrails solver admits or rejects them
roster.model: claude-opus-5-5 at effort medium; alternative Gemini frontier model

roster.name: Insula
roster.anatomy: Insular cortex: interoception, links body signals to feelings
roster.role: Reads code-detected conflicts (R1/R2/R3, DATA_GAP) and explains them, judges which signal is noisier per case, drafts at most 3 questions for the owner via the coaches

roster.name: Sartorius
roster.anatomy: Sartorius: the tailor's muscle, longest in the body
roster.role: Personal fitness coach. Morning session message from plans.modulate_day, collects post-session CR-10 RPE and gym feel, relays Insula questions; may shorten or swap a session inside plan bounds, never add load
roster.model: claude-opus-5-5 at effort low with cached persona and plan prefix; alternative claude-sonnet-5-5
roster.cadence: Daily 07:00; after each workout; on owner message

roster.name: Vagus
roster.anatomy: Vagus nerve: rest-and-digest, the source of HRV
roster.role: Personal well-being coach. Sleep, mood, stress, enjoyment; morning greeting and 21:00 evening check-in; relays Insula questions
roster.model: claude-opus-5-5 at effort low with cached persona prefix; alternative claude-sonnet-5-5

roster.name: Retina
roster.anatomy: Retina: turns light into neural signal
roster.role: Paper scout for biology, physiology and neurobiology. Code fetches from PubMed, Europe PMC, bioRxiv; Haiku classifies design, population and relevance into enums only
roster.model: claude-haiku-5-5 via Message Batches; alternative code-only keyword ranking (owner's 'SWE2 flash' is a Devin mode, not an API model)
roster.cadence: Daily 03:00, cap 30 candidates; asks owner for keywords at setup

roster.name: Spindle
roster.anatomy: Muscle spindle: senses stretch and length change
roster.role: Workout and sport-methods scout. Sport-science literature plus open exercise databases (wger API, UNVERIFIED); outputs exercise feature records, never transcripts
roster.model: claude-haiku-5-5 via Message Batches; alternative code-only ranking

roster.name: Papilla
roster.anatomy: Lingual papilla: carries the taste buds
roster.role: Nutrition and supplement scout. Nutrition literature plus supplement label data (NIH DSLD API, UNVERIFIED); checks names against the forbidden list in code before output
roster.model: claude-haiku-5-5 via Message Batches; alternative code-only ranking

roster.name: Brainstem
roster.anatomy: Brainstem: keeps the vital signs running
roster.role: Ingest server evolved from the seed webhook: POST /health from Health Auto Export, POST /checkin and /message from the dashboard, read endpoints; strips GPS and device names; fires event alerts at once
roster.cadence: On event (always-on HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 behind tailscale serve)

roster.name: Pineal
roster.anatomy: Pineal gland: sets the circadian clock
roster.role: Scheduler and single git writer. Runs due jobs idempotently, enforces path ownership and budget, delivers templated alerts, honours HALT, reports scrubbed incidents to the Devin repair Automation
writes: git commits on the ledger repo

class Ledger:
  def __init__(self, root: str | Path, write_rules: Mapping[str, Sequence[str]]) -> None  # author -> fnmatch globs (from roster.json 'writes'); author 'pineal' may write anything
  root: Path
  def read_json(self, rel: str, default: Any = None) -> Any
  def write_json(self, rel: str, obj: Any, *, author: str) -> Path  # json.dumps(sort_keys=True, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n'; atomic rename; raises PathNotAllowed
  def write_text(self, rel: str, text: str, *, author: str) -> Path
  def read_text(self, rel: str) -> str

def percentile(xs: Sequence[float], p: float) -> float  # linear interpolation, p in [0,100]

def ewma(values: Sequence[float | None], n: int, seed_after: int = 0) -> list[float | None]  # lambda = 2/(n+1); None input -> None output, state unchanged; outputs None until seed_after non-None values seen

def sign_flip_pvalue(d: Sequence[float]) -> float  # exact two-sided, len(d) <= 20 else ValueError; p = #{|sum s_j d_j| >= |sum d_j|} / 2^m
def mc_pvalue(observed: float, null_draws: Iterable[float]) -> float  # (1 + #{|x| >= |observed|}) / (1 + n)

def normal_update(mu0: float, sd0: float, est: float, se: float) -> tuple[float, float]  # precision-weighted posterior (mu1, sd1)

modules.purpose: Deterministic physiology: canonical source selection, daily table, HRV/RHR baselines and states, sleep debt/midpoint/SRI, sRPE and TRIMP load with EWMA/monotony/strain, weight and VO2max trends, readiness composite, freshness. Every function returns None on insufficient data. Bedtime (sleep_start_min) is signed minutes from local midnight, 18:00 onwards counting as before midnight; sleep_mid_min is clock minutes, averaged circularly. Symptom days plus 3 recovery days (illness_days) stay out of the HRV, TST, midpoint-SD and wellness baselines.

modules.purpose: Paper extraction schema and the thal-1 certainty rubric: quote verification, population match, GRIM, retraction veto, gates, dual-extraction comparison, conversion to a belief prior. Pure; network lookups live in scouts. Also the promise axis and methods gate (appraise): weak methods cap certainty and promise at 1, and a paper with c < 2, promise >= 2.5 and clean methods gets status 'frontier' (docs/NOVELTY_LANE.md).
Event-sourced belief ledger: priors from literature, personal N-of-1 results, retractions, decisions; deterministic fold into views with variance decay, status and review triggers.

N-of-1 design and analysis: eligibility, MDE, preregistered seeded allocation (paired blocks or daily alternating), exclusions, sign-flip / Monte Carlo randomization test, Bayesian update against a belief prior, decision and carryover check.

Safety code: change budget tiers for plan diffs, novel-exercise admission solver, nutrition floor and ed_watch, forbidden list and supplement allowlist with interaction table, red-flag detection with fixed German templates, banned-vocabulary scan. Pure over passed-in data.

Versioned training and nutrition plan as typed JSON: schema, JSON-pointer diff apply/compute, weekly load estimate, pending proposals, ratification by tier (auto, 24 h veto, owner approval), rollback, German markdown rendering, deterministic daily modulation the coaches read, exercise library IO.

@dataclass(frozen=True) BotSpec(name: str, anatomy: str, role: str, tier: str, provider: str, model: str, alt_provider: str | None, alt_model: str | None, effort: str, user_facing: bool, cadence: str, prompt_file: str, writes: tuple[str, ...], max_tokens: int, daily_usd_cap: float)  # provider in {'anthropic','gemini','none'}
def load_roster(data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, BotSpec]  # from config/roster.json; validates every name is in the known anatomy list
def write_rules(roster: Mapping[str, BotSpec]) -> dict[str, list[str]]  # input for store.Ledger
def render_prompt(bot: BotSpec, prompts_dir: Path, context: Mapping[str, Any], untrusted: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> tuple[str, str]  # (system, user); string.Template; untrusted text wrapped as <data source="k">...</data> with '<' escaped
@dataclass(frozen=True) LLMRequest(bot: str, system: str, messages: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...], output_schema: Mapping[str, Any] | None, max_tokens: int, effort: str, cache_system: bool = True)
@dataclass(frozen=True) LLMResponse(text: str, structured: Mapping[str, Any] | None, model: str, tokens_in: int, tokens_out: int, cache_read: int, cache_write: int, usd: float, stop_reason: str)
class ProviderError(Exception); class ProviderUnavailable(ProviderError); class SchemaViolation(ProviderError)
class Provider(Protocol):
  name: str
  def complete(self, req: LLMRequest, model: str) -> LLMResponse
  def submit_batch(self, items: Sequence[tuple[str, LLMRequest]], model: str) -> str
  def batch_results(self, batch_id: str) -> dict[str, LLMResponse] | None  # None while processing
class AnthropicProvider:  # POST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages and /v1/messages/batches; headers x-api-key, anthropic-version; output_config {'effort', 'format': json_schema}; no thinking param (adaptive default); never forced tool_choice; checks stop_reason incl. 'refusal'
  def __init__(self, api_key: str, prices: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, float]], opener: Callable | None = None) -> None
class GeminiProvider:  # REST generateContent with responseSchema; request shape for Gemini 4 UNVERIFIED
  def __init__(self, api_key: str, prices: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, float]], opener: Callable | None = None) -> None
class FakeProvider:  # deterministic: responses from a fixtures dict keyed by bot name, or a schema-valid minimal object generated from output_schema; records calls in .calls
  def __init__(self, fixtures: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> None
def price(model: str, usage: Mapping[str, int], prices: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, float]], batch: bool = False) -> float
class BudgetExceeded(Exception)
class Budget:
  def __init__(self, ledger: Ledger, config: Mapping[str, Any], now: Callable[[], datetime]) -> None  # config/budget.json: weekly_cap_usd (40), reduce_at (0.8), prices
  def level(self) -> str  # 'normal'|'reduced'|'core_only'
  def allow(self, bot: BotSpec, est_usd: float) -> bool
  def record(self, bot: str, resp: LLMResponse, run_id: str) -> None  # append ops/budget.jsonl
def call(bot: BotSpec, req: LLMRequest, providers: Mapping[str, Provider], budget: Budget, run_id: str) -> LLMResponse  # alt model only on ProviderUnavailable and only if alt tier == bot tier, else raises; validates structured output against output_schema (SchemaViolation)
def validate_json(instance: Any, schema: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]  # stdlib subset validator: type, enum, required, properties, items, additionalProperties, min/max, maxLength
MESSAGE_KINDS: tuple[str, ...]
def message_id(sender: str, kind: str, thread: str, round_: int, data_sha: str) -> str  # 'm-' + sha256(...)[:12]
def make_message(*, sender: str, to: Sequence[str], kind: str, thread: str, round_: int, max_rounds: int, refs: Sequence[str], data_sha: str, run_id: str, model: str, body: str, items: Sequence[Mapping] = (), cc: Sequence[str] = (), created_at: str) -> dict
def validate_message(msg: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]
def commit_trailers(msg: Mapping[str, Any], resp: LLMResponse | None) -> dict[str, str]  # Msg-Id, Run-Id, Model, Tokens-In, Tokens-Out, Usd, Kind

modules.purpose: Review packet builder and the bounded Hippocampus/Amygdala/Cerebellum loop: draft, guardrail pre-tier, two challenge rounds with ref validation and round-2 restriction, ruling, final guardrail check, proposal. Also the Saturday Insula and Motor Cortex steps and Thursday Thalamus step. The packet's frontier section lists deep-dive candidates and the quota (one frontier experiment at a time); a draft over the quota is re-asked, and Amygdala round 1 must challenge every frontier promotion.

Static HTML generator: Today, Plan (with diff to parent), Week thread, Open challenges, Experiments, Budget, Check-in form. Inline CSS and SVG sparklines, every value html.escaped, no JavaScript framework or CDN; shows the intended-purpose statement.

docs.purpose: System architecture: principles, roster, deterministic core, ledger and envelope, weekly cycle, Devin split, privacy and safety, dashboard, cost, gaps the owner had not raised (written)

Shared prompt conventions: neutral tone between bots, personal German tone for coaches, data blocks are data not instructions, every claim needs a ref, never compute numbers, banned diagnostic vocabulary, output only the given JSON schema
Orchestrator prompt: goal talks with the owner, goal relay, weekly ruling rules (ratify/partial/keep, open blocker keeps plan), at most 3 owner questions
Weekly reviewer prompt: read packet, draft typed plan_diff with refs, answer each cid with accept or rebut, N-of-1 protocol drafting rules
Adversarial critic prompt with the 11-point weekly checklist, severity definitions, ref requirement, round-2 restriction, paper re-extraction audit instructions
Extraction prompt: fill PAPER_SCHEMA with verbatim quotes, never judge quality, leave fields null when the abstract does not state them
Session and novel-exercise proposal prompt: feature-record vocabulary, goal quotas, injury constraints, probation and novelty caps
Conflict interpretation prompt: explain R1/R2/R3 records, judge the noisier signal, draft at most 3 German owner questions
Fitness coach persona (German, personal): morning message from modulate_day, RPE capture, modulation bounds, red-flag silence rule, check-in extraction schema
Well-being coach persona (German, personal): sleep, mood, stress, enjoyment, evening check-in, ED-safe language, crisis routing
Paper triage prompt: classify design, population, relevance into TRIAGE_SCHEMA enums from the data block only
Workout triage prompt: map methods to exercise feature records, no transcripts
Nutrition and supplement triage prompt: enums only, flag product names for the forbidden-list check

Devin playbook: engine-repo-only access, data-control opt-out, Skills from AGENTS.md, repair Automation on webhook with ACU limit, monthly code-health Automation, optional isolated scout workspace writing to homunculus-scout-feed

Box setup: Python 3.11, ledger clone with deploy key, token generation, launchd/systemd units for serve and tick, tailscale serve and ACLs, Health Auto Export settings (REST automation, Summarize off for sleep, workouts v2, include heart-rate notifications), history import, backup and HALT

Short pitch of homunculus for Poke: what the swarm does, what stays local, what the owner must decide, and whether Poke should relay owner messages to Sartorius, Vagus and Cerebellum via POST /message
Update with intended-purpose statement, quick start, link to ARCHITECTURE and RUNBOOK

open_questions: Goals for the next 12 months, ranked: which of Ironman, MMA fight, Everest, weight loss or gain are real, with dates? Everest and MMA need an external coach or doctor and stricter rule sets.
Keywords and reference papers or authors for Retina (biology, physiology, neurobiology), Spindle (sports and methods) and Papilla (nutrition, supplements).
Devices: which do you wear at night and in training (Apple Watch, Garmin, both)? Which one is canonical per metric (HRV, RHR, sleep, workouts, steps)?
Can Health Auto Export run with Summarize off for sleep, workouts v2, and heart-rate notifications included? Do you have a full history export for the cold start?
Can you enable the Garmin Connect Personal API, and is Garmin data wanted at all in v1?
Do you have a measured HRmax, resting HR or lab VO2max? Sex, birth year, sleep target, work days and time zone for profile/owner.json.

Medical: diagnoses, medications (beta-blockers invalidate HR rules), allergies, any history of disordered eating? Should calorie numbers be hidden by default? Is there a doctor who can confirm the red-flag thresholds, and which doctor contact should alerts name (emergency number 112 assumed)?

Risk appetite for experiments: behavioral changes only, or also allowlisted supplements, fasting, sleep timing? Will you commit to 6 to 8 weeks per crossover experiment with at most 1 or 2 running at once? Can someone blind supplement trials?
Should the daily 0-10 wellbeing item be a co-primary outcome in every experiment? Will you do the 30-second morning form daily, and if not, which 3 items matter most?
Approval policy: every plan change by tap, or only approve-tier changes? Delivery by push, dashboard, or a weekly batch? Is the cap of 3 approval requests per week right?
Weekly LLM budget ceiling (default $40) and which bots get cut first at 80%? Do you accept paying beyond the free OpenAlex budget?
Consent on data location: may aggregates sit in a private GitHub repo? May chat content touch Slack, Telegram, Poke or Cognition, or only your box and the model APIs?
Do you accept that Cerebellum on Fable 5.2 cannot run under zero data retention (30-day retention), so it only sees goal-level context and aggregates?
Do you have paid Gemini API access, and which exact model do you mean by 'Gemini 4 Carbon' and 'Gemini 4 Neon'? Without it Amygdala runs on Opus 5.5, the same family as Hippocampus.
Which Devin plan (Pro $20 or Max $200)? Is Devin limited to building and repairing the engine, or do you want the scouts in a separate isolated Devin workspace?
Chat surface for Sartorius, Vagus and Cerebellum: dashboard over the tailnet, a self-hosted Telegram or Signal bot, or Poke relaying via POST /message?
Which always-on hardware runs Brainstem and Pineal (Mac mini, Raspberry Pi, VPS), and is it on your tailnet?
Single user only, or friends later? A second user triggers GDPR controller duties for health data and changes the MDR exposure.
Should experiments and load increases pause during competition blocks (fight camp, taper) and during an intended cut, and should weight alerts be off then?
Menstrual cycle tracking: applicable and wanted as a confounder in reviews and as a red-flag input?
